Optionally include a decorative pure-CSS mini bar chart of tonight's KP values inside a glass panel (marked `aria-hidden` with an `sr-only` text summary). 3. **Features (`#features`)** — exactly 3 glass cards: *Live KP index tracking* (`monitoring`), *Hyperlocal visibility windows* (`travel_explore`), *Storm alerts that beat the rush* (`notifications_active`). Each: glass icon circle, title, one specific sentence of copy. 4. **How It Works (`#how-it-works`)** — exactly 3 numbered step cards (01 `pin_drop` "Set your location", 02 `satellite_alt` "We watch the solar wind", 03 `bolt` "Your phone lights up first") with a horizontal connector line on desktop only, hidden on mobile. 5. **Testimonials (`#testimonials`)** — 3 glass quote cards: 5-star rating, realistic quote, initials avatar in a gradient glass circle, name + location (e.g., Tromsø, Fairbanks, Reykjavík). 6. **Pricing (`#pricing`)** — exactly 3 tiers: *Stargazer* $0, *Aurora Chaser* $9/mo (featured: "Most popular" ribbon, elevated glass, gradient border, primary CTA), *Expedition* $29/mo (ghost CTA). An optional monthly/yearly billing toggle may be added; if built, it must use a `role="group"` segmented control with `aria-pressed` buttons and update price text accessibly. 7. **FAQ (`#faq`)** — accordion with 6 items (What does "KP" mean? How accurate is the forecast? Do I need total darkness? When is aurora season? Can I cancel anytime? Which countries are covered?). Full accordion spec in §3.4. 8. **Final CTA (`#cta`)** — centered glass panel over an aurora glow: `h2` "Never miss a storm again.", email signup form (spec in §3.3), microcopy "Free to start. No spam. Unsubscribe anytime." 9. **Footer** — brand blurb, 3 columns of secondary links (Product: Features / Pricing / FAQ; Company: About / Blog / Contact; Legal: Privacy / Terms / Cookies), social links rendered as **text pills** (Material Symbols has no brand logos — do not fake them with icons), and an auto-updating copyright year. **1.3 Color Palette & Visual Direction (authoritative)** - Base palette: `#060a18`, `#dce6f2`, `#03050e`, `#071026`, `#0a1a33`, `#0b1220`. A restrained aurora green (`#3fe0ac` family) is the sole accent, reserved for gradients, glows, focus rings, and success states — never for body text. - **Light mode is the default theme** (per source spec) and must receive equal polish: frosted pale-blue surfaces with dark navy text, aurora glows rendered via `mix-blend-mode: soft-light` at reduced opacity. **Exception clause:** although the source spec designates Light as default, a fully tokenized Dark mode remains mandatory per §2.3; on first visit, default to Light unless `prefers-color-scheme` reports dark. **1.4 Required CSS Techniques (all must appear)** - `backdrop-filter` (+ `-webkit-backdrop-filter`) for every glass surface, with an `@supports not ((backdrop-filter: blur(1px)) or (-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(1px)))` fallback that raises glass background alpha to ≥ 0.85 and keeps layout identical. - `mix-blend-mode` on aurora blob layers (`screen` in dark mode, `soft-light` in light mode). - CSS filters on aurora blobs: `blur()` + slow `hue-rotate()` inside keyframes. - Keyframe animations (aurora drift, status-dot pulse, skeleton shimmer, spinner), transitions, transforms, multi-stop gradients, box shadows, border radius — all driven by tokens. **1.5 Typography & Icons (Google only)** - Fonts: **Space Grotesk** (500/600/700) for `--font-display` headings; **Inter** (400/500/600) for `--font-base`. Load via Google Fonts `` with `preconnect` and `display=swap`. - Icons: **Material Symbols Rounded** via Google Fonts stylesheet with `display=block`, base `font-variation-settings: 'FILL' 0, 'wght' 400, 'GRAD' 0, 'opsz' 24`, and an `.icon--filled` modifier (`'FILL' 1`) for rating stars. **Inline SVGs, local icon fonts, and emoji icons are forbidden.** **1.6 Copy Rules** - Author all user-facing copy in **English**, specific to the aurora-forecast product (you may adapt the copy brief in §1.2, but keep it concrete). **Lorem ipsum is forbidden.** Every interactive element needs visible, meaningful text. --- ## 2.
